using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap, cost;
};

struct MCMF {
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    MCMF(int n_) : n(n_), g(n_) {}

    void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        if (cap <= 0) return;
        Edge f{to, (int)g[to].size(), cap, cost};
        Edge r{from, (int)g[from].size(), 0, -cost};
        g[from].push_back(f);
        g[to].push_back(r);
    }

    pair<int,int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int need) {
        const int INF = INT_MAX / 2;
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        vector<int> dist, prevv, preve;
        while (flow < need) {
            dist.assign(n, INF);
            prevv.assign(n, -1);
            preve.assign(n, -1);
            vector<bool> inq(n, false);
            queue<int> q;
            dist[s] = 0;
            q.push(s);
            inq[s] = true;
            while (!q.empty()) {
                int v = q.front(); q.pop();
                inq[v] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[v].size(); ++i) {
                    const Edge &e = g[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost;
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        if (!inq[e.to]) {
                            inq[e.to] = true;
                            q.push(e.to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            int add = need - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v])
                add = min(add, g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            flow += add;
            cost += add * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= add;
                g[v][e.rev].cap += add;
            }
        }
        return {flow, cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin.exceptions(ios::failbit);

    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    vector<int> starts(N, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        int a;
        cin >> a;
        --a;
        ++starts[a];
    }

    int maxT = K + N + 1;
    int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
    int src = V - 2;
    int sink = V - 1;

    MCMF mcf(V);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        if (starts[i])
            mcf.addEdge(src, i, starts[i], 0);

    for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; ++t)
        mcf.addEdge(t * N, sink, K, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int t = 0; t < maxT; ++t)
            mcf.addEdge(t * N + i, (t + 1) * N + i, K, C);

    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        --u; --v;
        for (int t = 0; t < maxT; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                int c = C + (2 * j + 1) * D;
                mcf.addEdge(t * N + u, (t + 1) * N + v, 1, c);
                mcf.addEdge(t * N + v, (t + 1) * N + u, 1, c);
            }
        }
    }

    auto ans = mcf.minCostFlow(src, sink, K);
    assert(ans.first == K);
    cout << ans.second << '\n';
    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap, cost;
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> pot, level, iter;

    MinCostFlow(int n_) : n(n_), g(n_), pot(n_, 0) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        Edge a{v, (int)g[v].size(), cap, cost};
        Edge b{u, (int)g[u].size(), 0, -cost};
        g[u].push_back(a);
        g[v].push_back(b);
    }

    bool bfs(int s, int t) {
        level.assign(n, -1);
        queue<int> q;
        level[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (const Edge &e : g[v]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0 && e.cost + pot[v] - pot[e.to] == 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (int &i = iter[v]; i < (int)g[v].size(); ++i) {
            Edge &e = g[v][i];
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[v] + 1 && e.cost + pot[v] - pot[e.to] == 0) {
                int ret = dfs(e.to, t, min(f, e.cap));
                if (ret) {
                    e.cap -= ret;
                    g[e.to][e.rev].cap += ret;
                    return ret;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int sendBlocking(int s, int t, int limit) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (flow < limit && bfs(s, t)) {
            iter.assign(n, 0);
            while (flow < limit) {
                int f = dfs(s, t, limit - flow);
                if (!f) break;
                flow += f;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    pair<int,int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int need) {
        const int INF = INT_MAX / 2;
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        vector<int> dist(n);

        while (flow < need) {

            if (pushed == 0) break;
            flow += pushed;
            cost += pushed * pot[t];

        return {flow, cost};
